prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Sentinel Vale: EO mission (land/coastal/cryosphere). Ground segment plans, acquires, operates safely, generates/archives products, controls access; excludes spacecraft, launch, user processing. Mission Control Center (Bluebell): real-time ops, anomaly response, releases validated commands, owns contact schedule, primary routing policy; contact = readiness check, live monitoring, post-pass closure; coordinates with PPF; sends constraints to Mission Planning System (MPS), receives command preparation package. Spacecraft Operations Team (SOT): console lead declares pass status, authorizes commands, pauses on telemetry mismatch; uses Antenna Deicing Notice; receives maneuver recommendation package when conjunction risk exceeds threshold. Escalation: console>discipline lead>mission management. Possible fault: preserve command state, no discretionary commanding. Command stack queued only with MCC+SOT concurrence. Command Validation Gateway (Osprey): shall validate stacks (syntax, timing, ranges, sequencing, mode, schedule, maneuver vs burn plan); shall reject unapproved edits, missing provenance, expired config, out-of-window; consults Telemetry Ingest Service (verifies manifested delivery), Orbit Determination Engine. Cybersecurity Desk reviews command-prep exceptions; receives Security Exception Ticket from Ground Network Manager (Juniper). Flight Dynamics Facility (Mistral): orbit catalog; sends Star Tracker Mask File; ephemerides to MCC, MPS, PPF; deliveries shall include validity interval, frame, generation time, use statement. Flight Dynamics Team: uses Doppler Residual Report; collision screening; produces Ephemeris Delta Note. Orbit Determination Engine: produces Laser Retroreflector Window. Network Control System (Lantern): routing, station allocation; sends MCC antenna status, link config; uses Security Exception Ticket to restrict transfer paths; shall preserve last validated routing and reject unreviewed changes during product transfers. Payload Calibration Team: maintains calibration baseline, produces Calibration Patch Bundle. Product Quality Service (PQS): checks orbit solutions; uses patch bundle; assigns quality flags; produces Product Hold List; delivery hold on failed checks/missing ancillary/blocking review. Long Term Archive (Granite): stores orbit, maneuver, quality records, released products (operational/test/reprocessed); sends Storage Watermark Snapshot daily. Payload Processing Facility (Forgehouse): Primary Processing Cluster (L0,1A,1B,L2) records build/calibration/ancillary versions; Backup Processing Cluster takes over (same image/rules), writes fallback provenance used by PQS; both down: suspend,

New part:
S176: Recovery after suspension prioritizes products with contractual latency commitments, then processes remaining scenes in acquisition order unless mission management approves a different backlog rule.
S177: Long Term Archive is the authoritative repository for Sentinel Vale raw downlink, auxiliary data, processing inputs, generated products, and operational metadata after routine production has completed.
S178: Archive admission begins only after Payload Processing Facility has delivered the product package, associated quality metadata, and checksum evidence required by the configured acceptance rule.
S179: Each accepted object is assigned a persistent identifier that remains stable across media migration, catalogue refresh, and later reprocessing campaigns.
S180: The repository stores object content separately from searchable metadata so that catalogue publication can proceed without exposing internal storage paths.
S181: Catalogue records are published to User Services Portal after Product Quality Service has set the public quality status and the embargo rule has been evaluated.
S182: Products under operational review remain discoverable only to authorized mission staff until the release condition is cleared.
S183: User Services Portal provides search, preview, order, and download functions through a browser interface and documented machine interfaces.
S184: Download services support resumable transfer, integrity verification, and rate controls that protect mission operations from excessive external demand.
S185: Registered users receive authorization scopes based on mission policy, contractual access rights, and applicable data licensing constraints.
S186: Anonymous access is allowed only for product classes that have been approved for open dissemination by mission management.
S187: Long Term Archive retains raw acquisition data for the life of the mission and for the post-mission preservation period defined in the archive policy.
S188: Standard Level 1 and Level 2 products are retained online while demand, contractual latency, or reprocessing dependence justifies low-latency access.
S189: Older product copies may be moved to lower-cost storage when catalogue metadata, checksums, and restore procedures remain available.
S190: Deletion is performed only against superseded temporary products, expired working copies, or objects covered by an approved disposal rule.
S191: Retention exceptions require traceability to the approving authority, the affected product classes, and the expected operational impact.
S192: Reprocessing is triggered when calibration improvements, processor corrections, orbit updates, or quality investigations materially change product fitness for use.
S193: Payload Calibration Team may request a reprocessing campaign when validation evidence shows a systematic radiometric or geometric issue.
S194: Mistral publishes orbit quality state changes to the archive operations queue before catalogue validity flags are updated.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
